discipline_note: Candidate IDs are provisional. This delta is a census of what the concept actually invokes, adjudicated against the packet's candidate families. No canon is minted here.

preserve_or_reuse_checked.evidence: Account rows in the provider surface switch the active profile without re-authenticating.
Route differences show requested vs effective and offer the switch back.
Usage is a boundary card here (manager-usage): Settings shows balances and links out. Whether refresh belongs to Settings or to the Usage owner is unresolved.
No concept exports usage; the Usage owner keeps that command.

retire_or_alias_checked.evidence: No concept in this folder contains a chip/bloom surface; the string does not appear in any source file. A compatibility alias is only needed if the old command is still bound in the shipped catalog.
